config.note: Performance (time, chunks/s) and quality metrics are reported separately; there is no combined score. Metrics describe behavior on this synthetic fixture corpus only; no strategy is universally better. N/A means the metric did not apply (e.g. no headings in the document) and is excluded from averages; it is never reported as 0. The semantic chunker uses a deterministic fake embedding model by default so the algorithm comparison is reproducible; --semantic-embedding local uses the cached local transformer model and never downloads weights.
